title: Education Heat Map
shortDescription: A D3.js choropleth of US educational attainment by county.
description: A freeCodeCamp data visualization project: a D3.js choropleth that joins TopoJSON county shapes with education data, with a color legend and hover tooltips.

technicalDetails.approach: Loaded two datasets asynchronously, joined by FIPS code, mapped values to a threshold color scale and rendered SVG paths with tooltips.

visualization.label: Share of adults with a bachelor's degree (illustrative shape)
